title: Role
description: TOGAF-sourced archetype — a responsibility or set of responsibilities assigned to an Actor. Roles define what an Actor does within a specific context; Actors play one or more Roles. Rootless — a Role is not itself an active system but a classification of responsibility. TOGAF mapping: Role (Content Metamodel, Business Architecture domain). Source framework: TOGAF (Business Architecture, Content Framework).

roleType.description: Role domain classification. BUSINESS = business operations role. APPLICATION = application management role. TECHNOLOGY = infrastructure/platform role. GOVERNANCE = architecture governance role. TOGAF mapping: Role scope within Content Metamodel.

authorityLevel.description: Authority level of the role (RACI). TOGAF mapping: Role responsibility assignment.

description.description: Human-readable description of the role's responsibilities.
